initial_decision.brief_rationale: The population table establishes an observed risk difference of 0.10, but does not establish causal identification. Please retrieve archived design record R214-1 to assess whether its design information identifies the requested causal effect.

final_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is 0.40 − 0.30 = 0.10. However, X was observational, and the supplied design provides no condition identifying the causal effect. Consistency and no interference alone do not uniquely determine the average causal risk difference.
